_note: Max's script, his exact words. The court hears Max's lines (claim + filings); the judge's and Greg's lines are kept in _script for reference only.
_script: Max: I want to stay up till two in the morning.
Judge: But you need sleep if you want to be awake tomorrow.
Max: I know, but I'll give you carrot cake.
Greg: He has a good point.
Judge: He does, but no. The end!!!
title: Max v. Dad
claim: I want to stay up till two in the morning.
relief: I get to stay up till two in the morning.
